title: Infrastructure DNS Entity
description: Common properties shared by all authoritative DNS server implementations (BIND, PowerDNS, CoreDNS, Knot).

listen_address.description: Address the DNS server listens on.

listen_port.description: Port the DNS server listens on.

zones.description: DNS zones served by this server.

allow_transfer.description: IP addresses allowed to perform zone transfers.

recursion.description: Whether to enable recursion (authoritative servers usually disable this).
